[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The matched equivalences are proved only after imposing the lower- and upper-shell-richness inequalities, numerical restrictions tailored to the bespoke two-reservoir lower-bound witness; on the broader uniform one-sided-shell class, the note proves only upper bounds and coverage. Consequently, the four-channel frontier is settled for a paper-constructed reservoir-rich subclass, not for the general shell model or a published weak-overlap class. The estimator and interval also require the tail exponent, shell constants, and all nuisance-error radii as supplied inputs, while adaptive attainment is left open. The TL;DR and honest-scope sections disclose these restrictions, so there is no stale matched or sharp claim outside the explicitly restricted class.

DIRECTED IMPROVEMENT (re-derive the SAME object implementing this, do not reproduce the prior note): Replace the two-reservoir lower-bound witness with a construction valid without the lower- and upper-shell-richness inequalities, and extend both the risk converse and honest-length converse to the broader class already covered by the estimator.
